Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding the humane treatment of cows.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the humane treatment of cows; adding newsections to chapter 16.52 RCW; providing an effective date; andprescribing penalties.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in subsection (2) of this section, no personmay: (a) Dock any cow, or procure the same to be done, within the state; (b) Import or bring into the state any docked cow; (c) Drive, work, use, or deal in any docked cow within the state. (2) The prohibitions in subsection (1) of this section do not applywith respect to a cow whose tail was docked for the purpose of savingthe animal's life or relieving the animal's pain in an emergency or forother veterinary purposes, provided that all of the followingconditions are met: (a) The treatment or operation is carried out by a veterinarianlicensed pursuant to chapter 18.92 RCW using only suitable instrumentsand in hygienic conditions; p. 1 HB 1787 (b) Adequate anesthesia is used to minimize the animal's pain andsuffering during the treatment or operation; and (c) The treatment or operation is performed in such a manner as tominimize the longterm pain and suffering of the animal. (3) Any person who violates this section has committed a class 1civil infraction, punishable as provided in RCW 7.80.120. Eachindividual instance of an act prohibited in subsection (1) of thissection involving an individual cow is considered a separate anddistinct violation. (4) The definitions in this subsection apply throughout thissection unless the context clearly requires otherwise. (a) "Cow" means any animal of the bovine species. (b) "Dock" means the intentional shortening of an animal's tail bycutting or removing any portion of the solid part of the tail.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The practice of docking, as defined in section 1 of this act, isnot an acceptable animal husbandry practice.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 16.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The provisions of this chapter are in addition to, and not in lieuof, any other laws protecting animal welfare. This chapter may not beconstrued to limit any other state law or rule protecting the welfareof animals, nor does anything in this chapter prevent a local governingbody from adopting and enforcing its own animal welfare laws andregulations. In the event of a conflict between this chapter and anyother provision of law, this chapter controls.

If any provision of this act or itsapplication to any person or circumstance is held invalid, theremainder of the act or the application of the provision to otherpersons or circumstances is not affected.
